_about: Every word on the base screen. Rule: max 12 words per sentence, max 2 sentences. {n}, {max} and similar are filled in by the game.

power.name: Power
power.explain: Power runs every machine. The Sun makes it.

air.name: Air
air.explain: Air means oxygen. The crew breathes it all day.

food.name: Food
food.explain: Food comes from the greenhouse. The crew eats every sol.

time.name: Time
time.explain: You get {n} time points each sol. Walking uses 1.

shield.name: Shield
shield.explain: The shield blocks radiation. Radiation is invisible energy that can hurt bodies.

dust.name: Dust
dust.explain: Dust on the panels blocks sunlight. Less sunlight means less power.

science.name: Science stars
science.explain: Stars show the science you did. They raise your score.

dose.name: Dose
dose.explain: Dose is how much radiation got into the crew. Too much is a Mission Pause.

power.name: Power Room
power.about: Solar panels and the battery live here.

air.name: Air Room
air.about: This machine makes oxygen for the crew to breathe.

shelter.name: Shield Shelter
shelter.about: Thick walls keep the crew safe from radiation.

cleanPanels.name: Clean the panels
cleanPanels.about: Less dust means more power tomorrow.

makeOxygen.name: Make oxygen
makeOxygen.about: The machine turns power into air.

growLights.name: Turn on grow lights
growLights.about: Plants make food over the next 2 sols.

science.name: Do science
science.about: Study Mars and earn a star.

fixAirMaker.name: Fix the air maker
fixAirMaker.about: Takes time. Then the machine makes full air again.

hud.solExplain: A sol is one day on Mars. It is about 40 minutes longer than Earth's day.
hud.gameSizedExplain: These numbers are made small for the game. Real bases use bigger numbers.
hud.flarePoints: {n} flare points. Each shield level blocks 1.

panel.tapRoom: Tap a room to walk there.

reasons.noTime: Not enough time. You need {n}, you have {have}.
reasons.notEnough: Not enough {stat}. You need {n}, you have {have}.
reasons.limit: Done for today. Try again next sol.

confirmNewGame: Start a new game? Your base will reset.

askEarth.delayNote: That took {s} seconds here. A real message takes minutes each way!

predict.title: What do you think will happen?
predict.sub: Pick one. Then the night begins.

report.title: Sol {n} Report
report.heat: Heaters kept the base warm. Mars nights are freezing.
report.flareAll: A class {cls} flare hit. Your shield blocked it all!
report.flareSome: A class {cls} flare hit. The shield blocked {blocked}. {through} got in.
report.flareNone: A class {cls} flare hit. No shield! {through} got in.
report.shieldFade: The shield faded a little overnight.
report.sunDusty: The Sun makes power. Dust blocks some light.

debrief.title: Here is why
debrief.wrong: Good guess! Testing ideas is what scientists do.
debrief.notebook: Added to your Mars Notebook! Cards: {n}

pause.title: Mission Pause
pause.air: The crew ran out of air tonight. People need air all the time.
pause.food: The crew ran out of food tonight. Plants grow slowly, so plan ahead.
pause.power: The heaters ran out of power tonight. Save power for the night.
pause.dose: Too much radiation got in. Raise the shield before a flare.
pause.tipAir: Try: make oxygen before the night.
pause.tipFood: Try: turn on grow lights a sol early.
pause.tipPower: Try: keep {n} power for the heaters.
pause.tipDose: Try: raise the shield as high as the flare size.
pause.calm: Nothing is lost. Try a new plan!
pause.stuck: From this morning, no plan can save Sol {n}. Earlier choices matter!

complete.title: Mission complete!
complete.body: You kept the base alive for {n} sols. Great job, Mars helper!

coach.bars: These 3 bars keep the crew alive. Tap one to learn more.
coach.rooms: Tap a room, or walk with the arrow keys or WASD. Walking is free!
coach.panel: Each button shows its cost first. Try one!
coach.endsol: Done planning? Tap here. Then the alert starts.

labels.exampleFlare: No real flare data yet. Run npm run fetch-nasa.

map.hint: Tap a room, or walk with the arrow keys or WASD.
map.hintTouch: Tap a room, or drag the joystick.

alert.title: ALERT: {title}
alert.noTimePoints: No Time Points in the alert. Fixes cost seconds and supplies.
alert.stopped: You left the room, so the work stopped.
